title: A fork PR whose need already landed internally is left open: make the close-with-thanks step at landing impossible to skip (missed on #19342 for two days)
body:
Filing category: ③ maintainer-directed task.

The maintainer gave this instruction on 2026-09-23 in the PM session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx` (the `domain:spec` seat 2). Verbatim:

> 这种pr应该写个评论直接关闭。

> "这种 PR"都应该这样处理，开一个 skills 卡片

"这种 PR" means a fork PR whose need has already landed through an internal PR.

## What happened

- Fork PR #19342 (contributor `jinyitao123`) became card #19489, which landed as internal PR #19534. It merged 2026-09-21T10:32Z as `2aac821a8c`, and that commit carries `Co-authored-by: jinyitao123`. The card closed as completed.
- #19489's body said the seat would close #19342 "in the landing stroke". Two comments on #19342 made the same promise to the contributor. Nobody closed it.
- #19342 stayed open for two days with no word to the contributor, until the maintainer asked about it. It was closed 2026-09-23T14:42Z with a thank-you and the landing link (comment `5796916550`).
- The rule already exists: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/external-contributions.md` step ③ says 「内部 PR 落地后关闭 fork PR,附致谢与落地链接」. It is prose only. No landing step reads it, and no sweep catches a miss.

## Ask (`domain:skills` seat)

Make the close impossible to forget. Follow the order `SKILL.md` gives for a failure fix: first remove the construct that allows the error, then make the right form the only spelling, and only then add a check. The seat picks the shape. Two candidates:

- **A. At the landing step.** When a landing card names a fork PR it adopted, the same landing step posts the thank-you with the landing link and closes that fork PR.
- **B. In the triage sweep.** Step ① already scans open PRs whose head repo ≠ base repo on every fire. Add one arm: if the fork PR's card was closed as completed by a merged PR, post the thank-you with the landing link and close the fork PR.

Also state what happens when the need is declined (the card closes `not_planned`). Today the text covers only the landed case.

## Reading at filing

- **Open fork PRs:** 0 of 25 open PRs have a head repo other than `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, measured 2026-09-23T14:47Z with `GET /pulls?state=open`, after #19342 closed. #19342 is the known member of that set, with head `jinyitao123/objectstack`. So no fork PR is waiting now; this card is about the next one.

## Dedupe

Queries run with `search_issues` on objectstack:

- "close fork PR after internal PR lands with thanks and landing link": 4 hits, all closed. None of them covers this gap. #19470 is the fork-PR intake ruling card; #17160, #13587 and #9178 are unrelated.
- "external contribution fork pull request intake card-first sweep": 0 hits.

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`) on the maintainer's direct instruction. The lane `domain:skills` is the one the maintainer named. Not claimed.
